Container.Name: Livrarr
Container.Overview: Self-hosted ebook and audiobook library manager for the *arr ecosystem — finds, grabs, organizes, enriches, and reads your books. Single container, single SQLite database.
Container.Description: Self-hosted ebook and audiobook library manager for the *arr ecosystem. Set PUID/PGID to your Unraid user (default 99:100). Livrarr fixes ownership of /config automatically; ensure /books is writable and /downloads readable by that user.

Config.Name: Config
Config.Description: Database, covers, config.toml (ownership auto-fixed to PUID:PGID)

Config.Name: Books
Config.Description: Your ebook/audiobook library root (must be writable by PUID:PGID)

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Download client complete dir (must be readable by PUID:PGID; same host path as your client)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id Livrarr runs as (Unraid default 99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group id Livrarr runs as (Unraid default 100)
